subject: Provisional net terms, credit ceiling and VAT certification
messages:
From: Sana Iqbal <sana@medicore.io>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: paul.oneill@medicore.io
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 15:12:00 +0100
Subject: Request: Net45 + provisional credit line (PO 7782) / VAT question

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the demo last week — Medicore is keen to proceed with a pilot and we've attached PO_7782.pdf for a two-month pilot (approx. €82,000 estimated). Before we sign, procurement asked me to confirm the proposed payment cadence and VAT handling. A couple of items: 

- We'd prefer Net45 for the pilot to help with cashflow. Is that acceptable provisionally while we ramp?
- Can Redwood invoice our UK entity (Medicore Healthcare Ltd) with UK VAT applied, or do you require we accept EU invoicing and handle VAT via reverse charge?
- We'd like a provisional credit ceiling of €120,000 to avoid having to prepay during the pilot.

Can you confirm what evidence you need (VAT certificate, PO, bank ref), and how quickly you can turn around a provisional credit assessment? We can get the VAT cert and company reg within the day.

Appreciate a quick reply — procurement wants this in the system by end of week.

Best,
Sana Iqbal
Head of Procurement | Medicore
Sana.Iqbal@medicore.io | +44 20 7946 0123
[attachment: PO_7782.pdf]

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Iqbal <sana@medicore.io>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 18:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: Net45 + provisional credit line (PO 7782) / VAT question

Hi Sana — thanks for the PO and for flagging timing. Quick response below and next steps so procurement can progress the ticket: 

1) High-level proposal (provisional):
   - Pilot invoicing: 70% invoiced on delivery + 30% on completion (two invoices, staged).
   - Payment terms: Net45 for the first two invoices during pilot, subject to the provisional credit assessment.
   - Credit ceiling: provisional cap of €100,000 while we complete finance checks (we can expand to €120k after satisfactory evidence).

2) VAT approach:
   - If Medicore prefers Redwood to invoice the UK entity with UK VAT, we will need your UK VAT registration document.
   - If no UK VAT registration is provided, we typically invoice from an EU entity and request the customer handle VAT via reverse charge where applicable.
   - We can indicate VAT on the invoice and include the VAT number to support your reclaim. Please confirm the preferred flow.

3) Required evidence for provisional credit (please provide):
   - Signed PO (received)
   - VAT registration certificate for the invoiced entity (medicore_vat_certificate.pdf)
   - Company registration excerpt or CRO (incorporation)
   - One bank reference or recent payment confirmation from another vendor (if available)

4) Timeline and next steps:
   - If we receive the VAT cert + company reg by EOD tomorrow, finance will aim to complete the provisional assessment within 48 hours.
   - I'll prepare a short provisional agreement (non-obligatory) that captures the Net45/staged invoice approach; Marcus will review credit sizing.

I'll attach the draft provisional agreement and send to you for signature (DocuSign) once Marcus confirms the ceiling.

Thanks — tagging Marcus for the credit sizing: @marcus_lin — any adjustments on the ceiling?

—
Olga Petrov
Account Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0191

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, Sana Iqbal <sana@medicore.io>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:17:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: Net45 + provisional credit line (PO 7782) / VAT question

Thanks Olga — quick finance note:

- We can approve a provisional credit ceiling of €110,000 for the pilot on the following conditions: 25% upfront deposit on the first invoice, staged invoicing as you outlined, and monthly reconciliation during the pilot.
- If Medicore provides the UK VAT cert and a satisfactory company reg extract, we can move to €120,000 and retain Net45 for the remaining invoices.
- If no bank reference is available, we'll require a short supplier reference call (5–10 mins) with the contact you provide.

I suggest the following conservative language in the provisional agreement:
  - Provisional Credit Limit: €110,000 effective for 60 days from first invoice.
  - Deposit: 25% of the first invoice due on receipt (to be applied to that invoice).
  - Payment Terms: Net45 for subsequent invoices; if payment performance degrades we reserve the right to convert to prepaid terms.

Olga — I attached a draft (Redwood-Provisional-Agreement-v1.pdf) with these terms. If Medicore accepts, send back the VAT cert + incorporation and we'll issue the DocuSign powerform link.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Finance, Customer Ops
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0144

From: Paul O'Neill <paul.oneill@medicore.io>

Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 18:34:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Request: Net45 + provisional credit line (PO 7782) / VAT question

Hi Olga / Marcus — thanks for the quick turnaround. Medicore is happy to proceed on the conditional terms: 

- We can provide the UK VAT registration (attached) and company reg extract by EOD today (see medicore_vat_certificate.pdf).
- We accept the 25% deposit on the first invoice and the provisional credit limit of €110,000 to start. Please issue the DocuSign link and we'll sign the provisional agreement, then you can issue the first invoice.
- For clarity on VAT: please invoice Medicore Healthcare Ltd with UK VAT shown and include our VAT number on the invoice; we will reclaim per local rules. If Redwood prefers reverse charge we can accommodate, but our procurement would prefer an explicit VAT invoice for internal routing.

Next steps: send DocuSign + final invoice schedule and we'll complete signing/payment.

Regards,
